analysis:
The PR changes one documentation line in docs/provider/cli-reference.md, head line 1732. It adds a row to the LaunchAgent environment passthrough table for DARKBLOOM_CBV2_PREFILL_CHUNK and DARKBLOOM_CBV2_STEP_TOKENS, citing EngineV2Factory+Configuration.swift (prefillChunkKey, stepTokenBudgetKey). The supplied evidence is docs only. It does not show the Swift change that makes LaunchAgent.swift forward these variables, so whether that change exists, and how those keys are parsed and bounded, needs checking in the code PR or a later pass.

Security relevance is limited. The variables are scheduler tuning values, not secrets. They are forwarded only from the invoking operator's shell into the operator's own plist. ADV-001 already controls that environment (TB-003), so this adds no new privilege. The values could affect memory use or availability (T-016 or T-029 class) only for the operator's own provider. They do not touch attestation, encryption, the coordinator trust boundary, the prefix-cache TTL, the cache scope, or the App Attest authorization (T-041, T-053 and TB-011 are unchanged).

Open question for the code side: the new keys should be bounded, including tighten-only or clamped by the memory admission checks. This cannot be verified from the supplied text. I raise no finding because a missing external implementation is not evidence of a regression. The units covered are the three base text segments, which show surrounding passthrough context and contain no changed lines. The patch itself was examined.
